name: Kunstraum Dornbirn
funding: City of Dornbirn, Land Vorarlberg and the federal state, plus members and unnamed sponsors.

name: Grazer Kunstverein
funding: Federal arts ministry, City of Graz and Land Steiermark culture department. Patrons: AVL List, Industriellenvereinigung Steiermark, Weitzer Hotels, legero united, Weingut Peter Skoff.

name: TAXISPALAIS Kunsthalle Tirol
funding: Tirol's regional kunsthalle; funders not named in readable site text.

name: Ars Electronica Center
funding: City of Linz and Linz AG (municipal utility) are core partners, with Siemens, KUKA, Land Oberösterreich, Dorotheum and ORF.

name: Albertina
funding: Annual partners Bank Austria and Verbund; partners BMW and Do&Co. The page says partners are capped at three but shows four logos.

name: Kunsthalle Wien
funding: City of Vienna (MA 7) core funding. Sponsors: Dorotheum, Ottakringer, Vöslauer, Winzerhof Dockner, Das Teppich Werk, Ton & Bild. 2026 programme support from Institut français and the Mondriaan Fund.

name: Leopold Museum
funding: Federal ministry subsidy. Sponsors: Siwacht, Post, PORR, Arbeiterkammer Wien, Dorotheum, im Kinsky; partner Wiener Städtische (insurer).

name: MAK - Museum of Applied Arts
funding: 2024: EUR 16.1M income, EUR 11.7M of it federal base funding; sponsors Porsche Holding Salzburg, Wienerberger, Wiener Städtische, Swarovski and others.

name: Secession (Wiener Secession)
funding: City of Vienna and the federal ministry. Erste Bank is main sponsor. Annual partners are Neuroth, Dorotheum and LG. 2026 partners are Arbeiterkammer and UNIQA.

name: mumok
funding: Federal museum funded by the Republic of Austria. Sponsors: Dorotheum, UNIQA, Gerngross, legero united. Patrons: Ludwig foundations and the Art Mentor Foundation Lucerne.
